lessons.title: Foreword

content.text: This handbook is prepared as a guide for use by drivers. It is a comprehensive information source for the rules and regulations, information and advice that you need to drive safely on the Kenyan roads. It is important for every learner to get adequate training and practice before being issued with a rider’s licence. You can become a safe rider through acquiring the necessary skills and understanding of the road environment, by always being alert and defensive and by accepting that the prime responsibility for your safety on the road is yours. This book will help learners prepare for the rider licence exam and also enable experienced riders to refresh their skills from time to time. NTSA

keyPoints: This handbook is prepared as a guide for use by drivers.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the Kenya Learner Driver Handbook?
options: To serve as a guide for safe driving on Kenyan roads
To provide a map of Kenyan roads

quiz.question: Who bears prime responsibility for your safety on the road?
Which legislation should every road user read alongside this handbook?
options: The Traffic Act and Highway Code

quiz.question: When may you use your car horn while stationary?
options: When another driver is at fault
To alert pedestrians at a crossing
You may not use the horn when stationary
